case_configuration.basis: Tonnel et al. (2023), Figure 4 most-accurate similarity-solution case, applied to the exact AvaFrame 2.1 avaSimilaritySol inputs

front_downstream_absolute_error_m.comparison: absolute difference between numerical and semi-analytical downstream positive-thickness front at t=20 s on the common output grid
front_downstream_absolute_error_m.tolerance_basis: two 3 m computational cells; the upstream run script couples meshCellSize to the 3 m kernel radius used by the published case

flow_thickness_relative_l2.tolerance_basis: conservative envelope above the published Figure 4 t=20 s thickness RL2 curve

flow_thickness_relative_linf.tolerance_basis: conservative envelope above the published Figure 4 t=20 s thickness RLmax curve

momentum_relative_l2.definition: AvaFrame ana1Tests.analysisTools.normL2Vect relative L2 norm of slope-normal thickness times Cartesian velocity
momentum_relative_l2.tolerance_basis: conservative envelope above the published Figure 4 t=20 s momentum RL2 curve

momentum_relative_linf.tolerance_basis: conservative envelope above the published Figure 4 t=20 s momentum RLmax curve

flow_velocity_relative_l2.definition: relative L2 norm of scalar speed, reported only where either solution has positive thickness
flow_velocity_relative_l2.tolerance_basis: upstream evaluates momentum rather than standalone velocity because velocity at a zero-thickness front is not a stable conserved comparison quantity

solver_mass_balance_relative_error.definition: absolute(final particle mass - initial particle mass) / initial particle mass
solver_mass_balance_relative_error.tolerance_basis: the published governing case has no mass source; this is a Lagrangian particle-mass conservation invariant with a floating-point allowance

initial_volume_relative_error.definition: absolute(numerical initialized volume - pi*Lx*Ly*H/2) / analytical volume
initial_volume_relative_error.tolerance_basis: one-boundary-cell quadrature allowance for a 3 m grid over 80 m release semiaxes

crs.acceptance: must remain explicitly undefined; the upstream analytical DEM has no CRS and must not be assigned the REL/rel1.prj metadata

overall_rule: pass only when every metric with a non-null threshold and every exact grid/unit/CRS/mask/domain invariant passes; diagnostic metrics must be finite but do not control pass/fail

not_applicable.pressure: The Hutter similarity solution and AvaFrame upstream analyzer provide no analytical pressure target.
not_applicable.field_validation: An analytical model-verification case is not an observation and cannot establish physical or local accuracy.
